# Lupi

Lupi is a browser-based molecular viewer for students and people inspecting structure data.
Canonical site: https://lupi.live
Source: https://github.com/alexwelcing/Lupi
Publisher and content steward: Lupi product owner.
Publication version: student-surface-2026-09-04. Maintained in this repository, not mirrored from a research site.

## Human workflow
Explore the curated collection, open a model or local XYZ/LAMMPS file, inspect, learn, export, and optionally sign in to save a shareable view.
https://lupi.live/study/organic-functional-groups

## Molecule pages
Every curated small molecule has a zero-canvas page with its ink drawing, PubChem-backed identity, handbook values and a link into 3D: https://lupi.live/m/<id> (index: https://lupi.live/m/, list: https://lupi.live/m/manifest.json).
Share card: https://lupi.live/og/m/<id>.png (1200x630). Desk models: https://lupi.live/ar/<id>.usdz and .glb.

## Agent interface
Edge manifest: https://lupi.live/mcp-manifest.json
Browser manifest: https://lupi.live/browser-mcp-manifest.json
These are different contracts. Edge V1 validates requests but does not render artifacts. Browser execution requires a mounted viewer.

## Boundaries
Distance-inferred visual bond guides are not source bond topology. Unknown properties remain unknown.
Research execution and scientific claim publication belong to the separate Lupine Science project. They are not the student app.
